claim_one_line: THE ROOM-THREE MEMBERS, SEALED. On N_45, the golden cover, at the 1024 characters nu of order 8 trivial on every cusp with nu^4 = chi0, the room-three order-2 character with the least key (the five room-three characters are one tau-orbit): by Theorem C (ii) with sm:B1545's Lemma F', a class reading I(W1) = -3 lies in the cup map's kernel K0^nu and vanishes on at least three of the five cusps (Corollary 1), so it lies in a stratum X_U = K0^nu ∩ {c vanishes off U}, |U| <= 2, with support exactly U; a generic class of each distinct stratum has the least I(W1) and the least I(Lambda^2 W1) there (Lemma G). The structure census (route R, no count): 424 distinct strata at 220 members (164 interior, 132 on one cusp, 128 on two). The run reads three generic classes of every distinct stratum in route F and route R at every member (2048 tasks, 1,272 readings per route) and route R's load-bearing checks at a generic class of K0^nu and of H^1 at every member. Controls K1-K8 hold. Predictions P1-P10 (P6 the floor 80%, P8 three 7%); PROVED if a stratum reads (-3, -3) in two routes; NEGATIVE if none reads I(W1) = -3 with I(Lambda^2 W1) <= -3, and then no class at any such member over the five carries three, in either order. No count at a member read. 0 of 19.
